meta.scope: Long-running five-phase persistent request-ring MVP. CPU writes small descriptors into a device-memory ring with H2D descriptor updates; one GPU persistent kernel polls the ring, runs phase-shifted lanes with dummy compute/HBM stages, and writes completion records. This is a real GPU persistent runtime mechanism with no per-request kernel launch, not a GR00T VLM/DiT compute implementation.

release_modes.0: burst: all lanes released together each service period
release_modes.1: phase: one lane released every phase gap
